metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:scope: Conditional on one fitted model and sampled training histories; no retraining or predictor changes.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:counts: Batch-local row IDs are not user IDs. Exclusions report empty rows, zero targets, length eligibility, and nonfinite values separately.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: (Mean sampled off-diagonal embedding cosine + 1)/2; finite nonzero catalog vectors only. A directional geometry statistic, not accuracy or recommendation diversity.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_pair_separation: Untransformed positive-minus-negative scores at nonpadding positions with both targets nonzero. Summary count excludes nonfinite margins; small means margin < 0.5, a scale-dependent threshold.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:fixed_pairs: Each intervention uses the original final nonpadding position's positive/negative pair. Readout uses masked physical position indices for both original and altered histories, never count-1.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:identity: Repeated ordinary inference on an unchanged cloned sequence in eval/no_grad mode. Any nonfinite eligible score or tolerance failure invalidates all intervention contrasts from that batch; excluded row-replicates are counted separately. With no checked rows, passed is null with a reason.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:prefix_deletion: For n >= 3, remove k=max(1,floor(0.2*(n-1))) oldest, most recent, or uniformly sampled prefix events, preserving the final event. Same k within each row.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:endpoint_deletion: For n >= 2, final-event and penultimate-event removal are separately labeled. Both retain the original candidate pair; final-event removal also changes the readout event.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:order_probes: Preserve length, padding, final item, and multiset. Shuffle the full prefix, swap disjoint adjacent prefix pairs, or shuffle before a suffix of min(3,n-1) events. At least two permutable events required. Identity draws and repeated item IDs may leave inputs unchanged; these remain in the denominator and are reported.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:coordinate_confounding: Deletion repacks retained events with left padding at fixed tensor length. It combines information removal with changes in coordinate distances and attention normalization. The supplied absolute embeddings use physical slots. Without instrumented controls, differences do not isolate temporal, positional, or causal preference effects.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:replicates: Five local seed-42 plans per condition and batch. Deterministic deletions repeat identical subsets; random plans may also repeat. Replicates are not independent fitted models, users, or observations for inference.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:raw_paired_records: Batch/row/replicate-indexed original and altered raw margins, altered-minus-original change, strict negative-wins indicator, sign-change indicator including ties, and feature cosine. Only finite eligible score pairs are included; missing scores and eligibility counts remain explicit.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:denominators: Margin and flip summaries use finite_pair_denominator. Cosine summaries use their own finite nonzero-feature count, with null/reason for undefined vectors. Empty measurements have null values and reasons. P10 uses NumPy's interpolated 10th percentile.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:dependence: Summaries weight sampled row-replicates, not unique users. No user-level bootstrap is justified without verified identity mapping. If later supplied, first aggregate histories/replicates within users, then bootstrap users within categories using 1000 seed-42 resamples; intervals are conditional on this fitted model and fixed candidates, not training-seed uncertainty.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:validation: Only unchanged host evaluation selects models using four-category macro HR@10, with its 200 users/category, target, 99 unique negatives, eligibility, and seed 42 fixed across any authorized paired comparisons. Training-pair flips are not validation rank changes.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:unavailable_attributes: No ratings, review text, item categories, prices, stores, or simulator traits are consumed. Public metadata/timestamps are not synthesized.
